QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Fighting Blind
QuestInfo.0: The Azwan fight holds a lot of promises, but prime minister Longorias seems to be worried. Why?
QuestInfo.1:
Longoria said that the battle will be tough, since Hilla's strength is influencing the entire Azwan region, excluding the top floor near the Obelisk. 

Countless people have come to aid Azwan, but they cannot distinguish one another as enemies or foes due to Hilla's power. They just may end up destroying one another... 

Longorias is worried about people fighting blindly in Azwan and getting hurt... but the battle can't be avoided.

0.0: The rewards are high because this fight will be dangerous.
0.1: The Obelisk's protective aura only reaches us here. Most of the other areas of Azwan are still under Hilla's influence.
0.2: I assure you, the battle may be tough, but the treasures we have to offer will make it more than worth your time.

yes.0: Are you prepared to fight? You might experience a humiliating defeat or leave with nothing but a grudge.

no.0: Surely you can see the reason in this fight.
